item.title: Special fijivillage Straight Talk Public Forum on Online Safety to be held at 7pm tomorrow
item.description: A special fijivillage Straight Talk Public Forum with Vijay Narayan will go live at 7pm tomorrow. The theme of the forum is Online Safety: Connected and Protected?
item.content:encoded:
A special fijivillage Straight Talk Public Forum with Vijay Narayan will go live at 7pm tomorrow.

The theme of the forum is Online Safety: Connected and Protected?

The panelists for the public forum will be Online Safety Commissioner, Filipe Batiwale, Fiji Law Reform Commissioners David Solvalu and Valerie Narain.

The Straight Talk forum will focus on Online Safety Issues in Fiji, what is being faced by the Online Safety Commission, the feedback from the members of the public during the consultation process on the review of the Online Safety Act 2018, the call for age restrictions for Social Media, the response from victims, the changes being proposed and the reasons behind them amongst other issues.

The show will be broadcast live at 7pm tomorrow on our Facebook, YouTube and X.

item.title: Warren Mave wins bronze for Fiji at Pacific Rim Pastry final in Australia
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 03/09/2026 Warren Mave displayed incredible talent, precision, creativity and passion at the Australian Culinary Federation Restaurant Challenge, winning bronze in the Global Pastry Chef Challenge Pacific Rim Final.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 03/09/2026

Warren Mave displayed incredible talent, precision, creativity and passion at the Australian Culinary Federation Restaurant Challenge, winning bronze in the Global Pastry Chef Challenge Pacific Rim Final.

Mave, who is from Manuku Village on Batiki Island, created a stunning Fijian bure, showcasing the flavours, creativity and spirit of his island home in Melbourne.

New Zealand’s Russell Le Comte won gold, while Australia’s Lei Shang claimed silver.

Seven of Fiji’s finest chefs are competing in the tournament.

Mave, Maurisio and Masi competed in the Global Pastry Chef Challenge, while Ifraaz Hussein and Frances Wakeham from Sheraton Resort and Spa are competing in Team Challenge Category One.

Isireli Chong from Wyndham Resort and Filipe Miramira from Yasawa Island Resort are competing in Team Challenge Category Two.
